Member-only story Community Building Women In Tech Product Strategy Branding Technology How My Cats Became the Face of a Tech Ecosystem Tech doesn’t have to be boring. See how I used my pets’ personalities to build a cyberpunk brand and became the foundation of Jaxx’s Lab. Jael Saavedra 5 min read · Sep 25, 2026 -- 1 Listen Share Press enter or click to view image in full size Jaxx and VIVI are ready to engineer the future of the PurpleGrooves ecosystem. To understand how my two short-haired cats became the face of a cyberpunk tech lab, you first need context on the ecosystem they rule: PurpleGrooves . PurpleGrooves is a creative house that integrates technology, music, and culture . For this explanation, I want to focus on the tech side. Within this ecosystem, PurpleGrooves integrates other inner systems, such as: Purpletunes : A Music Identity Application. Fluency Match: A Language Practice Application. An AI Lab: Housed within the PurpleGrooves ecosystem. I started the AI Lab when I began training artificial intelligence models. While doing so, I realized there are endless possibilities in software development, text-to-speech, image-to-video, and beyond. The point is, once I had the products, it became clear that my problem wasn’t building the products or brands themselves. My biggest challenge was reaching my audience . -- -- 1 Written by Jael Saavedra 24 followers · 32 following Full-stack engineer building React & .NET products.
